asked.item: Is it because of low credits?
Same "Could not upload media to ..." error on Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook at once

verdict.reason: The Error Reference row for "Could not upload media to [platform]" with the same message on every platform covers credits, retrying and next checks.

steps.text: This error is not a rate-limit or credits problem.
Retrying the same media without changes will not help.
Open each failed post in Posts > Failed to read its exact error, because the cause can differ per platform.
Common causes are media that doesn't meet the platform's format or size specs, or a stale connection. For a stale connection, reconnect the account in Accounts and retry.
